name: Andria (Italy)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Andria (a crowned yellow lion rampant on blue) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Andria, a comune in Apulia; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Andria arms — crowned yellow lion rampant on blue, crowned, within branches
